diag_disclaimer: Disclaimer: Ekintu kino ekya AI kiweebwa amaanyi okuva mu kunoonyereza kw’ebisolo okuyamba mu by’enjigiriza. SSI kidda mu kifo ky’okuzuula obulwadde bw’abasawo b’ebisolo mu ngeri ey’ekikugu.
diag_intro: Londa obubonero bw’olaba mu mbizzi zo okukendeeza ku ndwadde eziyinza okukwatibwa.
diag_no_matches: Tewali kukwatagana kwa maanyi kuzuuliddwa okusinziira ku bubonero obuliwo kati. Nsaba weebuuze ku musawo w’ebisolo okukeberebwa obulungi.
dis_aflatoxicosis_desc: Obutwa obuva mu mpeke oba emmere erimu ekikuta ekivaako ekibumba okwonooneka n’okuzimba ekibumba.
dis_aflatoxicosis_prev: Weewale okuliisa emmere erimu ekikuta, tereka empeke mu mbeera enkalu, era kozesa ebisiba obutwa.
dis_anaplasmosis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuva ku nkwale obuleeta okukendeeza ku musaayi, omusujja, n’obulwadde bwa jaundice.
dis_anaplasmosis_prev: Teeka mu nkola pulogulaamu z’okufuga vector ne tick.
dis_anemia_desc: Etera okubeera mu baana b’embizzi ab’omunda abatalina kyuma.
dis_anthrax_desc: Obulwadde obw’amaanyi obuva ku bakitiriya obuyinza okukwata abantu.
dis_app_desc: Obulwadde bw’ekifuba obw’amaanyi obuva ku bakitiriya.
dis_ascaris_desc: Ekiwuka eky’omunda ekivaako amawuggwe n’ekibumba okwonooneka.
dis_asf_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obusiigibwa ennyo era obutta abantu obubunye mu West Africa. Tewali ddagala ligema liriwo.
dis_asf_prev: Okunyweza obukuumi bw’ebiramu n’okukugira okutuuka ku faamu.
dis_babesiosis_desc: Ekiwuka ky’omusaayi ekitambuzibwa enkwale ekivaako omusujja omungi, okukendeeza omusaayi n’omusulo omuddugavu.
dis_babesiosis_prev: Fuga enkwale ng’okozesa eddagala eritta enkwale era okuume ekkalaamu nga teziriimu bimera.
dis_biotin_deficiency_desc: Ebbula ly’emmere ekivaako ebigere okwatika, ebiwundu ku lususu, n’okulema.
dis_biotin_deficiency_prev: Okwongera ku mmere ne biotin era weewale wansi wa seminti omukalu era omubisi.
dis_brucellosis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuleeta okulemererwa okuzaala.
dis_bvdv_pig_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka ka Bovine Viral Diarrhea virus okuva mu kukwatagana n’ente, ekivaako okuggyamu embuto.
dis_bvdv_pig_prev: Embizzi zikuume nga zaawuddwa ku nte n’endiga, era zikugira okukwatagana kw’ebika ebisalagana.
dis_c_difficile_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya mu baana b’embizzi abaakazaalibwa ekivaako ekiddukano eky’amazzi n’okuzimba.
dis_c_difficile_prev: Okwoza bulungi n’okutta obuwuka mu biyumba by’okuzaala era okakasa nti enseke zifuluma nga bukyali.
dis_cassava_poisoning_desc: Obutwa bwa Cyanide okuva mu bikoola oba ebikuta bya muwogo ebibisi oba ebitali bituufu.
dis_cassava_poisoning_prev: Sekula, fumba, okukala mu musana oba okuzimbulukusa muwogo nga tonnaba kuliisa.
dis_clostridial_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuleeta okwonooneka okw’amaanyi mu byenda.
dis_coccidiosis_desc: Obulwadde obuva mu biwuka okusinga obukwata embizzi.
dis_cold_stress_desc: Omubiri okunyogoga ennyo mu baana b’embizzi, ekivaako okukankana n’okufa ennyo.
dis_cold_stress_prev: Waayo amataala ag’ebbugumu, creep boxes, era ekifo w’ozaala kikuume nga kikalu era nga temuli muyaga.
dis_congenital_tremor_desc: Embeera y’obusimu mu baana b’embizzi abaakazaalibwa ekivaako okukankana okw’amaanyi.
dis_congenital_tremor_prev: Weewale okukozesa ensigo okuva mu mbizzi ezikoseddwa era okendeeze ku situleesi y’okusiga ng’oli lubuto.
dis_csf_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obusiigibwa ennyo obufaananako ne ASF.
dis_csf_prev: Okugema n’okukuuma ebiramu mu ngeri enkakali.
dis_cysticercosis_desc: Omutendera gw’enkwaso (larval stage) y’ensowera y’omuntu mu binywa by’embizzi.
dis_deltacoronavirus_desc: Ekiddukano ekiva mu kawuka mu myaka gyonna.
dis_demodectic_mange_desc: Enkwaso z’olususu ezirabika obulungi ezireeta amabala n’obuzimba obutonotono.
dis_demodectic_mange_prev: Okulongoosa endya y’ekisibo, okwawula embizzi ezikoseddwa, n’okusiiga eddagala eritta acaricides.
dis_ear_biting_desc: Enneeyisa etali ya bulijjo ng’embizzi ziluma amatu ga bannaabwe mu kiyumba, ekivaako okufa.
dis_ear_biting_prev: Kendeeza ku mujjuzo, okulongoosa empewo, n’okugaggawaza ng’enjegere.
dis_ear_necrosis_desc: Ebiseera ebisinga kiva ku situleesi, omujjuzo oba yinfekisoni.
dis_ear_necrosis_prev: Okukendeeza ku density n’okujjanjaba yinfekisoni ey’okubiri.
dis_edema_desc: Kiva ku butwa bwa E. coli mu baana b’embizzi abavudde ku mabeere.
dis_emcv_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obuva mu nvunza obuvaako omutima okulemererwa mu bwangu n’okuggyamu embuto.
dis_emcv_prev: Teeka mu nkola enkola enkakali ey’okulwanyisa ebiwuka n’okukuuma emmere okuva ku bucaafu.
dis_endocarditis_desc: Obulwadde bwa valve y’omutima ekivaako omutima okulemererwa n’okufa amangu mu kiseera ky’okunyigirizibwa.
dis_endocarditis_prev: Yanguwa okujjanjaba endwadde z’ennyondo n’ebiwundu, era londa ku buzaale obusobola okukwatibwa.
dis_eperythrozoonosis_desc: Ekiwuka mu musaayi ekivaako okukendeeza ku musaayi.
dis_ergotism_desc: Obutwa bwa ffene okuva mu mpeke z’emmere ey’empeke ezirimu ergot, ekivaako okufa kw’ebitundu by’omubiri.
dis_ergotism_prev: Screen feed grains for dark ergot bodies era okyuse emmere erimu obucaafu.
dis_erysipelas_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuleeta ebiwundu eby’enjawulo ku lususu n’endwadde z’enkizi.
dis_fascioliasis_desc: Obulwadde bwa parasitic fluke obukosa ekibumba, obutera okubeera mu malundiro amabisi oba ag’entobazzi.
dis_fascioliasis_prev: Zitangira embizzi okuliisa mu bifo ebirimu entobazzi n’okufuga ensenene z’ebitosi.
dis_fmd_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obuvaako ebizimba ku kamwa n’ebigere.
dis_foot_rot_desc: Obuwuka obuleeta obuwuka obuyingira mu buvune mu bigere, ekivaako okuvunda n’okulema.
dis_foot_rot_prev: Ddabiriza seminti omukalu, wansi kuuma nga mukalu, era kozesa ebinaabirwamu bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
dis_gastric_torsion_desc: Okuzimba n’okukyusakyusa olubuto mu bwangu, ekivaako okufa amangu.
dis_gastric_torsion_prev: Weewale okuliisa emmere ennene oluvannyuma lw’okusiiba okumala ebbanga eddene era emmere ya buli lunaku ogigabanyemu ebitundu.
dis_glassers_desc: Kireeta okuzimba obuwuka obuyitibwa membranes okwetoloola omutima, amawuggwe, ennyondo.
dis_gossypol_toxicity_desc: Obutwa obuva mu kuliisa obuwunga bwa ppamba obubisi oba obuyitiridde, ekivaako obuzibu mu kussa.
dis_gossypol_toxicity_prev: Komya emmere ya ppamba mu mmere era kozesa iron sulfate okumalawo gossypol.
dis_greasy_pig_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuleeta ebiwundu by’olususu ebirimu amafuta.
dis_heat_stroke_desc: Okubuguma ennyo olw’empewo embi oba ekisiikirize.
dis_hydatid_disease_desc: Obulwadde bw’enkwaso (parasitic larval infection) obuleeta ebizimba ebijjudde amazzi mu bitundu by’omubiri.
dis_hydatid_disease_prev: Embwa z’oku ffaamu ziggyamu ensowera buli kiseera n’ozireme okulya ebitundu by’embizzi ebibisi.
dis_hyostrongylosis_desc: Obulwadde bw’ensowera mu lubuto ekivaako okuzimba olubuto, okukendeera kw’omusaayi, n’okugejja.
dis_hyostrongylosis_prev: Kyuusa amalundiro, ennyumba zikuume nga nkalu, era oteeke mu nkola enteekateeka y’okutta ensowera.
dis_ileitis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya mu kyenda ekitono.
dis_iron_toxicity_desc: Kiyinza okubaawo singa ekyuma kifukibwa mu baana b’embizzi ababulamu Vit E.
dis_iron_toxicity_prev: Kakasa nti emmere y’okusiga ebeera ya bbalansi.
dis_leptospirosis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuyitibwa Zoonotic bacterial disease obukosa ensigo.
dis_listeriosis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya mu nkola y’obusimu.
dis_mange_desc: Obulwadde bw’olususu obuvaako ebiwuka obuleeta obuzibu obw’ekitalo.
dis_melioidosis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya okuva mu ttaka/amazzi.
dis_mma_desc: Obulwadde bw’amabeere, obulwadde bwa metritis, ne agalactia ebivaako omusujja n’obutaba na mata mu nte oluvannyuma lw’okuzaala.
dis_mma_prev: Kuuma obuyonjo obukakali obw’ekiyumba ky’okuzaala n’okukakasa nti endya emala ey’okusiga.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuvaako ennyondo okuzimba, okulema, n’amagulu okunafuwa.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis_prev: Okulongoosa embeera y’amayumba, okukendeeza ku bungi bw’ebintu ebiterekeddwa, n’okujjanjaba nga bukyali.
dis_navel_bleeding_desc: Okuvaamu omusaayi omungi okuva mu nnabaana mu baana b’embizzi abaakazaalibwa.
dis_navel_bleeding_prev: Siba emiguwa gy’omu nnabaana ng’ozaalibwa era weewale okuliisa enkoko emmere erimu obutwa bwa mycotoxin.
dis_necrotic_enteritis: Obulwadde bw’omu lubuto obuyitibwa Necrotic Enteritis
dis_necrotic_enteritis_desc: Obulwadde bw’obutwa bwa bakitiriya obuleeta ekiddukano eky’amaanyi eky’omusaayi n’okufa ennyo mu baana b’embizzi.
dis_necrotic_enteritis_prev: Gema enkoko nga tonnazaala era okuume obuyonjo bw’ekkalaamu obujjuvu.
dis_oesophagostomiasis_desc: Ekiwuka ky’ekyenda ekivaako ebizimba mu bbugwe w’ekyenda, ekivaako enkoko ennyimpi.
dis_oesophagostomiasis_prev: Obuyonjo bw’ekkalaamu buli kiseera n’okukozesa eddagala eriweweeza ku bulwadde bwa broad-spectrum anthelmintics bulijjo.
dis_parakeratosis_desc: Obulwadde bw’endya obuleeta ebiwundu by’olususu eby’amaanyi ebizimba, ebigonvu.
dis_parakeratosis_prev: Kakasa nti omugerageranyo gwa calcium ne zinc gukwatagana mu mmere y’emmere era owe ebirungo ebiyamba zinc.
dis_pcv2_desc: Kireeta okusaasaana n’ensonga z’okussa mu balimi.
dis_ped_desc: Okufaananako ne TGE, kitta nnyo abaana abazaalibwa.
dis_phe: Obulwadde bw’omu lubuto obuvaamu omusaayi mu mbizzi
dis_phe_desc: Ekiddukano eky’omusaayi ogw’amaanyi n’okufa okw’amangu mu mbizzi ezirima/ezimaliriza.
dis_phe_prev: Kuuma obuyonjo obulungi era kozesa eddagala eritta obuwuka erisaanira wansi w’obulagirizi bw’omusawo w’ebisolo.
dis_photosensitization_desc: Okukola ennyo ng’okwokya omusana mu mbizzi ez’olususu olutangaavu oluvannyuma lw’okulya ebimera ebitongole.
dis_photosensitization_prev: Okuwa ekisiikirize, ggyawo omuddo oguwunyiriza, era embizzi zikuume mu nnyumba.
dis_pityriasis_rosea_desc: Embeera y’olususu etali ya kusiigibwa mu mbizzi ento ezikola ebikuta ebiringa empeta.
dis_pityriasis_rosea_prev: Ebiseera ebisinga okwesalirawo; okukuuma ebitanda ebiyonjo era ebikalu n’okukendeeza ku situleesi.
dis_pneumonia_desc: Obulwadde bw’okussa obutawona obuvaako okukula obubi.
dis_polyserositis_desc: Okuzimba kw’amawuggwe, omutima n’ennyondo mu baana abaggya ku mabeere mu ngeri ya fibrinous.
dis_polyserositis_prev: Kendeeza ku situleesi y’okuggya ku mabeere, weewale okutabula ebisasiro, era osse empewo ennungi.
dis_pox_desc: Obulwadde bw’olususu obuva ku kawuka, obutera okusaasaanyizibwa enkwale.
dis_ppv_desc: Ekitera okuvaako okulemererwa okuzaala mu gilts.
dis_prdc_desc: Obulwadde bw’okussa obutabuddwamu akawuka ne bakitiriya ekivaako okusesema n’okukula obubi.
dis_prdc_prev: Okulongoosa empewo, weewale okujjula, n’okufuga akawuka akasookerwako.
dis_pseudorabies_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obukosa enkola y’obusimu n’okussa.
dis_pwd_desc: Ekiddukano kya bakitiriya mu baana b’embizzi nga wayiseewo akaseera katono nga bavudde ku mabeere, ekivaako okuggwaamu amazzi mu mubiri.
dis_pwd_prev: Kendeeza ku situleesi y’okuggya ku mabeere, kuuma obuyonjo obw’amaanyi, n’okuwa amazzi amayonjo ag’okunywa.
dis_rabies_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka obutta abantu ebiseera ebisinga buva ku kulumwa.
dis_rabies_prev: Okugema ebisolo by’omu nnyumba n’okulwanyisa ebisolo by’omu nsiko.
dis_rectal_prolapse_desc: Ebiseera ebisinga kiddirirwa okusesema, ekiddukano oba situleesi y’omusujja.
dis_rotavirus_desc: Ekitera okuvaako ekiddukano okuva ku mabeere.
dis_salmonella_septicemia_desc: Obulwadde bwa salmonella obw’amaanyi mu musaayi obuleeta olususu olwa kakobe n’okufa amangu.
dis_salmonella_septicemia_prev: Okwawula embizzi endwadde, ddagala amazzi, era okuuma obukuumi obukakafu obw’ebiramu.
dis_salmonellosis_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuleeta ensonga ez’amaanyi mu byenda.
dis_salt_poisoning_desc: Kiva ku bbula ly’amazzi nga kigobererwa okunywa ennyo.
dis_shoulder_ulcers_desc: Amabwa aga puleesa ku bibegabega by’embizzi ennyimpi eziteekeddwa ku seminti omukalu.
dis_shoulder_ulcers_prev: Waayo ebitanda ebigonvu, kuuma enkoko nga ziri mu mbeera nnungi, era kozesa ebitanda bya kapiira.
dis_sow_hysteria_desc: Obuzibu mu nneeyisa ng’embizzi ezizaala zifuuka za bukambwe ne ziluma omwana w’embizzi.
dis_sow_hysteria_prev: Waayo embeera esirifu ey’okuzaala, londoola gilts, era kozesa eddagala eriweweeza ku bulwadde bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
dis_spirochetal_colitis: Obulwadde bw’olubuto obuyitibwa Spirochetal Colitis obw’embizzi
dis_spirochetal_colitis_desc: Obulwadde bw’ekiddukano obutono mu mbizzi ezikula, ekivaako okugejja obubi.
dis_spirochetal_colitis_prev: Okwoza mu bifo omuliira embizzi n’okujjanjaba embizzi ezikoseddwa n’eddagala eritta obuwuka.
dis_splayleg_desc: Embizzi ezizaalibwa nga tezisobola kuyimirira nga zirina amagulu ag’emabega.
dis_strep_desc: Obulwadde bwa bakitiriya obuleeta obulwadde bwa meningitis.
dis_strep_prev: Eddagala eritta obuwuka n’okukendeeza ku situleesi.
dis_strongyloidiasis_desc: Ensigo y’omu byenda ereeta ekiddukano eky’amaanyi n’okufa mu baana b’embizzi.
dis_strongyloidiasis_prev: Ebibokisi by’okuzaala bikuume nga bikalu era nga biyonjo, era n’okuggya ensowera mu nsigo nga tonnazaala.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity_desc: Obutwa obuva mu bitooke ebifuuse ekikuta, ekivaako obuzibu obw’amaanyi mu kussa.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity_prev: Suula ebitooke ebyonooneddwa oba ebifuuse ekikuta; liisa ebikuta ebiramu byokka.
dis_tetanus_desc: Obutwa bwa bakitiriya obukosa enkola y’obusimu.
dis_tge_desc: Obulwadde bw’akawuka nga bufa nnyo mu baana b’embizzi abato.

guide_breeding_step1_desc: Noonya okuyimirira (standing reflex), ekibumba ekizimba, n’amaloboozi. Wandiika empeereza y’obutonde oba AI n’ebikwata ku boar tag.
guide_breeding_step1_tip: Enkola esinga obulungi kwe kugabula enkoko emirundi ebiri: nga baawukanye essaawa 12 mu kiseera ky’ebbugumu ery’oku ntikko ng’eyimiridde.
guide_breeding_step2_desc: SmartSwine ekola otomatiki enteekateeka y’okukebera ebbugumu okuddamu ku nnaku 18-24 n’okulabula kw’okuzaala ku nnaku 110-114.
guide_breeding_step2_tip: Kebera oba ozzeeyo mu bbugumu okwetoloola Olunaku 21. Singa sow eraga ebbugumu eriyimiridde, ddamu okugikolako amangu ddala.
guide_breeding_step3_desc: Okutta obuwuka mu bibokisi by’okuzaala n’okutambuza enkoko z’embuto ng’ebula ennaku 4 ku 5 okutuuka ku lunaku lw’okuzaala olusuubirwa. Tegeka amataala ag’ebbugumu eri abaana b’embizzi.
guide_breeding_step3_tip: Ekifo ekiwujjo ky’embizzi kikuume nga kibuguma (30-32°C) okuziyiza ebbugumu eringi mu baana abazaalibwa.
guide_breeding_step4_desc: Log Born Alive, Stillborns, Mummies, ne Total Litter Birth Weight okwekenneenya enkola ya maama w’okusiga.
guide_breeding_step4_tip: Muwe empiso z’ekyuma era osala amannyo g’empiso mu ssaawa 24-48 ng’omaze okuzaala.
guide_breeding_subtitle: Londoola enzirukanya y’ebbugumu ly’okusiga, ennaku z’okugabula, olubuto olw’ennaku 114, n’okuzaala.
guide_feed_step1_desc: Genda ku ‘Feed’ oggulewo ekintu ‘Feed Formulation’ okukola oba okutereeza emmere ey’okuliisa ey’enjawulo.
guide_feed_step1_tip: Kebera emiwendo gy’ebirungo mu katale nga bukyali okuzuula ensibuko za puloteyina n’amasoboza mu kitundu ezisinga okukekkereza ssente.
guide_feed_step2_desc: Londa omutendera gw’embizzi ogugendereddwamu (Creep, Starter, Grower, Finisher, Gestating Sow, Lactating Sow) okutikka ebiriisa ebyetaagisa ebya mutindo.
guide_feed_step2_tip: Embizzi ezirima zeetaaga ebirungo ebizimba omubiri ebingi (16-18%) okusinga embizzi ezirina olubuto (12-14%).
guide_feed_step3_desc: Oteekamu ebirungo nga Emmwaanyi, Soya Meal, Wheat Bran, Fishmeal, ne Premix. Bbalansi ebitundu ku kikumi okutuusa ng’ebbaala z’ebiriisa zifuuse kiragala.
guide_feed_step3_tip: Kakasa nti omugerageranyo gwa Calcium ne Phosphorus (Ca:P) gusigala wakati wa 1.2:1 ne 1.6:1 okusobola okukula obulungi amagumba.
guide_feed_step4_desc: Teeka enkola yo ey’okufumba enzikiriziganya okusobola okufuna amangu, oba wandiika ekibinja ekitabuddwa okusobola okulongoosa mu ngeri ey’otoma yinvensulo y’emmere.
guide_feed_step4_tip: Tabula emmere mu bitundutundu ebifaanagana era otereke mu paleedi enkalu, ezigulumivu okuziyiza obutwa bwa aflatoxin n’okwonooneka.
guide_feed_subtitle: Dizayini emmere etali ya ssente nnyingi, erimu ebiriisa ku buli mutendera gw’okufulumya.
guide_finances_step1_desc: Wandiika ensaasaanya yonna ku faamu ng’egabanyizibwamu okusinziira ku mmere y’emmere, ey’obusawo bw’ebisolo, ey’abakozi, eby’okukozesa, n’okuddaabiriza.
guide_finances_step1_tip: Log expenses amangu ddala nga okugula kubaddewo kale okwekenneenya omuwendo kusigala nga ku mulembe.
guide_finances_step2_desc: Wandiika ssente eziyingira okuva mu kutunda ebisolo ebiramu, emirambo egyasaliddwa, ebisolo ebirundibwa oba obusa obw’obutonde.
guide_finances_step2_tip: Wandiika obuzito obulamu n’ebbeeyi esembayo buli kkiro okulondoola emigabo gy’akatale egyatuukirira.
guide_finances_step3_desc: Weekenneenye COP buli kkiro ne Finisher Breakeven price okukakasa nti buli transaction ekola amagoba amalungi.
guide_finances_step3_tip: Emmere y’emmere mu ngeri ennungi erina okukiikirira ebitundu 65-75% ku nsaasaanya yo yonna ey’okufulumya. Okukendeeza ku kwonoona emmere y’ebisolo.
guide_finances_subtitle: Londoola ensaasaanya, ssente eziyingira mu kutunda, era obala omuwendo gw’ebintu ebikolebwa buli kkiro.
guide_health_step1_desc: Kozesa ekintu ekizuula endwadde okukwataganya obubonero obw’obujjanjabi obwetegerezeddwa (okusesema, ekiddukano, ebiwundu) n’embeera z’embizzi eza bulijjo.
guide_health_step1_tip: Ebisolo ebirwadde byawula mangu mu biyumba bya kalantiini nga tonnatandika kujjanjabwa.
guide_health_step2_desc: Wandiika obujjanjabi bw’eddagala eritta obuwuka oba eritta obuwuka era weetegereze nnyo ennaku z’okuggyamu ennyama.
guide_health_step2_tip: Tosuubula oba kusala nsolo ng’eddirisa ly’okuggyamu ennyama enzijuvu terinnaggwaako.
guide_health_step3_desc: Kuuma ebifo ebinaabirwamu ebigere n’eddagala eritta obuwuka, okufuga abagenyi abagenda ku faamu, okuyonja mmotoka, n’okuteeka sitooka empya mu kalantiini okumala ennaku 30.
guide_health_step3_tip: Biosecurity ya buseere emirundi 10 okusinga okujjanjaba obulwadde obubalukawo.
guide_health_step3_title: Okussa mu nkola obukuumi bw’ebiramu ku faamu
guide_health_subtitle: Zuula obubonero, goberera enkola z’obujjanjabi, n’okukuuma obukuumi bw’ebiramu obukakafu.
guide_herd_step1_desc: Yingira mu ‘Herd Data’ okuva ku dashboard enkulu oba menu ya drawer okulaba registry yo yonna ey’ekisibo.
guide_herd_step1_tip: Osobola okusengejja ebiwandiiko by'ekisibo okusinziira ku mbeera (Active, Sold, Cull) ng'okozesa tabu z'embeera.
guide_herd_step2_desc: Koona ku '+' ekitengejja. Jjuzaamu ebikulu: Tag ID, Olulyo, Ekikula, Olunaku lw’amazaalibwa, n’ekifo ekkalaamu.
guide_herd_step2_tip: Teeka ID za tag ezitegeerekeka obulungi, ezituukiridde (e.g., SOW-001, BOAR-01) okusobola okwanguyirwa okulondoola mu faamu yonna.
guide_herd_step3_desc: Ggulawo kaadi y’ekisolo kyonna okuwandiika obuzito bwa minzaani bulijjo, okugema, okuggya ensowera, oba obujjanjabi.
guide_herd_step3_tip: Okupima buli kiseera kiyamba okubala Average Daily Gain (ADG) entuufu n’okuzuula obulwadde nga bukyali.
guide_herd_step4_desc: Embizzi ezirima zigatta mu biyumba ebiragiddwa oba mu bibinja by’ebibinja okusobola okulondoola obulungi obungi bw’ebiyumba n’emmere gye zinywa.
guide_herd_step4_tip: Weewale ebiyumba ebijjudde abantu okuziyiza enneeyisa y’okuluma n’okukakasa nti ebisolo bikula mu ngeri y’emu.
guide_herd_subtitle: Okuwandiisa ebisolo, okuddukanya obubonero bw’amatu, okugaba ebiyumba, n’okulondoola olunyiriri.
guide_hr_step1_desc: Okuwandiisa abakozi, abaddukanya faamu, n‟abasawo b‟ebisolo abeebuuzibwako nga balina olukusa lw‟okuyingira olukwata ku mirimu.
guide_hr_step1_tip: Okukugira okufuna ssente eri Admins ne Managers kikuuma ebiwandiiko ebikulu nga bikuumiddwa bulungi.
guide_hr_step1_title: Yongera ku Bammemba ba Ttiimu & Okugaba Emirimu
guide_hr_step2_desc: Muwe emirimu gya buli lunaku ng’okuliisa mu kkamera, okuyonja ekyuma ekifukirira, essaawa z’okuzaala, n’okuzuula ebbugumu.
guide_hr_step2_tip: Enkalala z‟emirimu ezitegeerekeka obulungi zitangira okusubwa okuliisa oba okulwawo lawundi z‟eddagala.
guide_hr_step2_title: Gabira Emirimu & Enteekateeka za Buli lunaku
guide_hr_step3_desc: Wandiika okusasula emisaala, bbonuusi, n’okuggyibwako okukuuma ebyafaayo by’omusaala ebitegeerekeka obulungi, ebitegekeddwa.
guide_hr_step3_tip: Bulijjo ssaako ebiwandiiko ku bbonuusi z’omulimu oba ssente z’omusaala okusobola okutegeera obulungi okubala.
guide_hr_subtitle: Dukanya abakozi, okugaba emirimu egya buli lunaku, okulondoola abayizi abajja, n’okuwandiika omuwendo gw’omusaala.

guide_weight_step2_tip: Target ADG eri abalimi b’ettunzi eri 650g - 850g/day wansi w’endya ennungi.

tip_100_content: Kuuma ebifo ebitegeerekeka obulungi ebikwata ku mbeera ez’amangu n’ebiragiro ebiteekeddwa okumpi n’omulyango oguyingira okulaba ng’amasannyalaze gavaako, amazzi agasaliddwako, oba obulabe bw’omuliro.
tip_10_content: Embizzi ez’obunene obufaanagana zikuŋŋaanyizza wamu nga zivudde ku mabeere. Kino kiremesa embizzi ennene okweyisa okufuga n’okukung’aanya emmere.
tip_11_content: Liisa eddagala eriyitibwa electrolyte solution erya layisi, erikolebwa awaka (ebijiiko bya ssukaali 5, ekijiiko ky’omunnyo 1/2 mu liita 5 ez’amazzi amayonjo) mu nnaku 3 ezisooka ng’ovudde ku mabeere okulwanyisa situleesi.
tip_11_title: Ekizigo ky’okuzza amazzi mu mubiri eky’awaka
tip_12_content: Bw’oba oliisa kasasiro w’omu ffumbiro eri abaggya ku mabeere, bulijjo mufumbe okumala eddakiika ezitakka wansi wa 30 okutta akawuka ne bakitiriya nga tonnaba kuliisa.
tip_13_content: Liisa emmere y’emu ey’okutandika okumala ennaku 5 oluvannyuma lw’okuggya ku mabeere nga tonnatabula mpola mu mmere y’omulimi okumala ennaku 7 okuziyiza ekiddukano.
tip_14_content: Mu kifo we weebase, muwe oluwuzi olunene olw’obusaanyi obukalu, ebikuta by’enku oba omuddo omukalu okukuuma embizzi ezivudde ku mabeere nga zibuguma nga tokozesezza bbugumu lya bbeeyi.
tip_15_content: Kakasa nti embizzi zonna zisobola okulya mu kiseera kye kimu ng’owaayo ebiyumba ebiwanvu, ebitono eby’emmere ey’embaawo oba seminti (nga 15-20cm of trough space buli kaana k’embizzi).
tip_16_content: Wanika ebikoola by’ebijanjaalo ebya kiragala ebyawuddwamu mu kkalamu y’okuggya ku mabeere. Embizzi zizikamula ekizikuuma nga zikola ne zitangira okuluma omukira.
tip_17_content: Teeka ekisero ekiyonjo eky’ettaka ery’ebbumba eppya, emmyuufu (okuva mu kifo ekiyonjo) mu kifo we bazaala/okuggya ku mabeere. Embizzi zigirya okufuna ekyuma eky’obutonde n’eby’obuggagga bw’omu ttaka.
tip_18_content: Teeka ebiyumba by’amazzi oba ebinywa enfuli wansi ekimala (back-height of the smallest piglet) embizzi zonna ezivudde ku mabeere zisobole okunywa amangu.
tip_19_content: Ggulawo enjawulo wakati w’ebiyumba bibiri eby’okuzaala mu wiiki nga tonnaggyako mabeere okuleka omwana w’embizzi okubeera n’abantu, okukendeeza ku kulwana nga bakuŋŋaanyiziddwa mu bibinja oluvannyuma.
tip_19_title: Okukolagana n’abantu nga tebannaba kuggya mabeere
tip_1_content: Emmere ey’omutindo ogwa waggulu yeetaagibwa nnyo. Kakasa nti embizzi zifuna amazzi amayonjo buli kiseera n’endya ennungi okusinziira ku mutendera gw’okukula kwazo.
tip_20_content: Fumba ebiva mu bulimi nga ebikuta by’ennyaanya, ebikuta bya muwogo, n’emizabbibu gy’amatooke okusaanyaawo obutwa obw’obutonde n’okulongoosa okugaaya.
tip_21_content: Okwongera ku mmere ey’ettunzi ng’olima ebirime by’emmere y’ebisolo ebirimu ebirungo ebizimba omubiri nga Moringa, Azolla, oba ebikoola by’amatooke ku faamu.
tip_22_content: Ensigo ezirina olubuto zikomye ku kkiro 2-2.5 ez’emmere buli lunaku okuzitangira okugejja ekivaako okuzaala okuzibu.
tip_23_content: Tabula ensibuko z’ebiwuziwuzi eby’omu kitundu eby’ebbeeyi entono nga omuceere, eŋŋaano, oba copra meal mu mmere y’olubuto lw’ensigo okuzikuuma nga zijjudde era nga zikkakkamu.
tip_24_content: Kozesa ebipipa by’obuveera oba endongo ezizzeemu okukozesebwa nga ziteekeddwamu ebinywa by’enfuli ng’enkola y’amazzi amayonjo ag’ebbeeyi entono eri ebiyumba by’embizzi byonna.
tip_24_title: Ebinywa eby’amaanyi ga Gravity eby’ebbeeyi entono
tip_25_content: Teeka ensawo z’emmere ku paleedi z’embaawo okuva wansi wa seminti n’ewala okuva ku bisenge okuziyiza obunnyogovu n’okukula kw’ekikuta.
tip_25_title: Okutereka emmere y’emmere mu sizoni y’enkuba
tip_26_content: Fumba kasasiro w’emmere ya wooteeri oba mu ffumbiro okumala eddakiika 30 okumalawo akawuka ka African Swine Fever ne Foot-and-Mouth disease.
tip_27_content: Kozesa emmere y’empeke ya wet brewer ng’omusingi gw’emmere ey’ebbeeyi, naye gikome ku bitundu 30-40% ku mmere y’emmere era giriise nga bupya okwewala obutwa mu kikuta.
tip_28_content: Teeka obutundutundu obutonotono obw’amanda g’enku mu biyumba by’abalimi. Embizzi zikamula okuyamba okusiba obutwa mu lubuto n’okukendeeza ku kiddukano.
tip_29_content: Liisa ensiga eziyonsa emmere entonotono 3 ku 4 olunaku lwonna (mu kifo ky’okulya emmere ennene emu) okuzikubiriza okulya ennyo n’okufulumya amata amangi.
tip_2_content: Obukuumi bw’ebiramu kye kisumuluzo. Komya abagenyi, waayo ebifo ebinaabirwamu ebigere, era kuuma enteekateeka enkakali ey’okugema n’omusawo w’ebisolo.
tip_30_content: Bw’oba otabula emmere ku faamu, sooka otabule ebirungo ebitonotono (vitamin, omunnyo, ebiriisa) mu kasooli akatono nga tonnatabula mu ntuumu enkulu.
tip_31_content: Ensigo y’amakoola ga Leucaena (ipil-ipil) ekoma ku bitundu ebitakka wansi wa 5% ku mmere, kuba erimu mimosine ekiyinza okuvaako enviiri okugwa n’okulemererwa okuzaala.
tip_32_content: Liisa enkoko ennyimpi emmere ey’enjawulo mu makkati g’olubuto, era okendeeze ku mmere y’embizzi ezirina amasavu okukuuma embeera y’omubiri nga nnungi.
tip_33_content: Okwoza ebifo eby’okunywamu buli lunaku. Singa amazzi galabika nga macaafu oba nga gakuwunya bubi, tegalina bulabe eri embizzi zo.
tip_34_content: Leeta embizzi mu bbugumu mu kiyumba ky’embizzi okuzaala, okusinga okuleka embizzi okudduka mu kisibo ky’embizzi.
tip_34_title: Okugatta mu ngalo mu Breeding Pen
tip_35_content: Gezesa ebbugumu ng’onyiga emikono gyo n’amaanyi ku mugongo gw’enkoko; singa ayimirira ddala n’akaluba amatu ge, aba mwetegefu okugatta.
tip_36_content: Siimuula ebiyumba by’abaana n’okutabula lime y’ebyobulimi n’amazzi (okusiimuula enjeru) okutta obuwuka ku bisenge ne wansi ku buseere.
tip_36_title: Obuyonjo mu kisenge ky'okuzaala ku buseere
tip_37_content: Embizzi enkalu enkalu ezizaalibwa amangu ddala ng’okozesa ensawo oba ebigoye ebiyonjo era ebikalu okuziyiza okunnyogoga n’okulwala okussa.
tip_38_content: Singa empiso z’ekyuma teziriiwo, siiga ettaka eriyonjo n’ekizigo kya iron-sulfate ku mabeere g’enkoko enkazi buli lunaku olwo embizzi zinywe ekyuma nga ziyonsa.
tip_3_content: Embizzi ezizaalibwa zikuume nga zibuguma era okakasa nti zifuna amazzi g’enkwaso mu ssaawa ezisooka nga zizaalibwa okuzimba abaserikale b’omubiri.
tip_40_content: Kozesa ekibokisi eky’embaawo eky’enjawulo nga kiriko bbaatule entono oba ebitanda ebibuguma (nga obusaanyi obukalu) okukuuma obubizzi nga bubuguma mu kifo we baseeyeeya.
tip_41_content: Naaba amabeere n’amabeere g’enkoko n’amazzi amayonjo agabuguma n’eddagala eritta obuwuka eritali ddene nga tennazaala okukuuma embizzi ezaakazaalibwa.
tip_42_content: Fulumya enkwaso mu ngalo okuva mu mabeere g’enkoko n’oziriisa abaana b’embizzi abanafu ng’okozesa empiso oba ekijiiko ekiyonjo.
tip_42_title: Okusika Enkwaso (Colostrum Squeezing) eri Embizzi Ennafu
tip_43_content: Laga olunaku lw’okuzaala ku kalenda; olubuto lumala ennaku 114 (emyezi 3, wiiki 3, ennaku 3), ekikusobozesa okuteekateeka ekkalaamu y’okuzaala.
tip_44_content: Kuuma gilts ezikyusibwa okuva mu bamaama ezaali n’obunene bw’ebisasiro, okukola amata amalungi, n’obuzaale obukkakkamu obw’okuzaala.
tip_45_content: Tambula embizzi ekuze ng’oyite ku biyumba ebya zaabu buli lunaku okugikubiriza okujja mu bbugumu nga bukyali n’okulaga obubonero obw’ebbugumu obweyoleka.
tip_46_content: Teeka ekibbo ky’amazzi amayonjo okumpi n’omutwe gw’enkoko ezaala esobole okunywa nga tesituka.
tip_46_title: Siga Amazzi Okufuna Mu kiseera ky’Okuzaala
tip_47_content: Linda okutuusa nga gilt ewezezza emyezi egitakka wansi wa 8 era ng’eri ku cycle yaayo ey’ebbugumu ey’okubiri oba ey’okusatu nga tonnamugatta okukakasa nti litter esooka esinga obunene.
tip_48_content: Embizzi empya z’oguze zikuume mu kiyumba eky’enjawulo ekitakka wansi wa mita 20 okuva ku kisibo kyo ekikulu okumala ennaku 30 okukebera oba teziriimu bulwadde.
tip_49_content: Teeka bbaafu y’akaveera etali nnene oba omupiira ogusaliddwa ekitundu nga gujjudde amazzi n’eddagala eritta obuwuka (nga chlorine oba lime y’ebyobulimi) ku mulyango gwa faamu.
tip_49_title: Okuteekawo Ekisaawe ky'Ekifo eky'Omupiira ekya DIY
tip_4_content: Okukwata obulungi obusa kiziyiza okuwunya n’endwadde. Lowooza ku kukola nnakavundira oba okukozesa kasasiro ng’ekigimusa ku birime.
tip_50_content: Embizzi ezirima, ezimaliriza, n’ezizaala zikuume mu biyumba eby’enjawulo okutangira embizzi enkadde okuyisa endwadde ezitawona eri ento.
tip_51_content: Tokkiriza bagenyi (naddala abagula embizzi abalala oba abalunzi) munda mu biyumba byo eby’embizzi. Teesa ku bizinensi ebweru w’ekifo ky’ekkalaamu.
tip_52_content: Zimba olukomera olwangu (ng’okozesa emiwemba, embaawo oba waya) okwetooloola ekifo awasimba embizzi okusobola okukuuma embwa ezitaayaaya, embizzi z’omu nsiko ne baliraanwa.
tip_53_content: Empiso ezikozeseddwa zitereke mu ccupa oba ekibbo eky’akaveera ekissiddwako ssimu nga tonnaziziika oba kuzisuula bulungi obutafuna buvune mu butanwa.
tip_53_title: Okusuula empiso mu ngeri etali ya bulabe
tip_54_content: Tokkirizangako baguzi ba mbizzi kuvuga loole zaabwe okumpi n’ebiyumba by’embizzi byo. Load ezitundibwa embizzi ku ggeeti ya ffaamu oba ku bbugwe ow’okwetoloola.
tip_55_content: Liisa embizzi ezirima ensigo z’amapaapaali ezibetenteddwa oba entangawuuzi ng’eddagala erya layisi, ery’obutonde okuyamba okukendeeza ku nvunyu ez’omunda.
tip_56_content: Bw’oba osiba emikira, ssaako obuwuka mu kintu ekisala mu mazzi agabuguma oba omwenge wakati w’abaana b’embizzi okuziyiza obuwuka.
tip_57_content: Okwoza n’okufuuyira ebiyumba by’embizzi buli wiiki n’eddagala eritta obuwuka erya layisi era erikola obulungi, okukakasa nti embizzi zitambuzibwa oba wansi zikala mangu.
tip_57_title: Okutta obuwuka mu kalaamu buli wiiki
tip_58_content: Kakasa nti embizzi yo ey’omu kisibo egemebwa n’okuggyibwako envunyu buli kiseera, kuba esobola okusaasaanya yinfekisoni mu nte zonna ezizaala.
tip_59_content: Teeka ku bbali ekkalaamu emu eyeetongodde, enkalu, ebuguma ku nkomerero y’ewala ennyo ku faamu okujjanjaba embizzi abalwadde okuva ku kisibo ekiramu.
tip_5_content: Olondoole enkula, ebyobulamu, n’ebyensimbi n’obwegendereza okuzuula emitendera n’okutumbula amagoba ga faamu.
tip_60_content: Embizzi enfu ziziike mu buziba obutakka wansi wa mita 2, nga ziri wala nnyo okuva ku nsibuko z’amazzi, era omulambo obikkeko lime y’ebyobulimi nga tonnaddamu kujjuza ttaka.
tip_61_content: Okuwa ekifo ekitakka wansi wa square mita emu buli mbizzi emalirizza okukendeeza ku kulwana, situleesi, n’ebiwundu by’olususu.
tip_62_content: Dizayini ennyumba z’embizzi ezirina enjuyi eziggule (ng’okozesa akatimba ka waya oba emiwemba) okusobozesa empewo ey’obutonde okufuuwa n’okuggyawo obuwoowo.
tip_63_content: Obusolya bw’ebyuma busiige langi enjeru oba bubikkeko ebikoola by’enkindu oba obusa okukendeeza ku bbugumu munda mu nnyumba y’embizzi mu nnaku ez’ebbugumu.
tip_64_content: Bw’oba oteeka wansi wa seminti, kwata kungulu n’ekisero okukola obutuli obutonotono embizzi zireme kuseeyeeya n’okulumya amagulu.
tip_65_content: Kozesa obusa obukalu oba ebikuta by’enku wansi omugumu okunyiga obunnyogovu, okukuuma embizzi nga nkalu n’okukendeeza ku mirimu gy’okuyonja.
tip_66_content: Okwoza obusa okuva mu biyumba buli lunaku. Omukka gwa ammonia omungi (ogulagibwa ng’amaaso gookya oba okuwunya ennyo) guyinza okwonoona amawuggwe g’embizzi.
tip_67_content: Ku mbizzi ezikuumibwa ebweru oba mu biyumba by’ettaka ebiggule, ziteekewo ekisiikirize ky’ebitosi ekiziyamba okunyogoga mu budde obw’ebbugumu.
tip_68_content: Okunaaba n’okusiimuula ebidomola by’emmere ey’embaawo oba seminti buli wiiki okuziyiza emmere enkaawa okuvaako olubuto okutabuka.
tip_68_title: Okwoza mu bifo by’emmere buli kiseera
tip_69_content: Wanika obucupa bw’obuveera obujjudde amayinja amatono oba emipiira gya kapiira mu biyumba okuwa embizzi eky’okuzannyisa, kikendeeze ku kulwana.
tip_6_content: Embizzi zive ku mabeere ku nnaku 28 ku 35 mu kifo ky’okuziggya ku mabeere nga bukyali. Kino kisobozesa abaana b’embizzi okukula nga ba maanyi n’okumanyiira emmere enkalu nga bakozesa eby’obugagga ebyangu eby’oku faamu.
tip_6_title: Emyaka gy’okuggya ku mabeere eri abalimi abatono
tip_70_content: Sima emiti egy’amakoola ku ludda olw’ebuvanjuba n’amaserengeta olw’ennyumba y’embizzi okusobola okufuna ekisiikirize eky’obutonde n’okuziyiza omusana ogw’amaanyi ogw’emisana.
tip_71_content: Wansi wa seminti muserengese katono (nga 2-3%) ng’oyolekera omukutu gw’amazzi agakulukuta olwo ekifo w’owummulira ne kisigala nga kikalu ate ekifo we bafunira obusa kifuuse kibisi.
tip_72_content: Waayo ebiyumba by’embuto oba ebitundu ebigabanyaamu embuto ssekinnoomu ng’okozesa embaawo ennywevu ez’omu kitundu okukuuma enkoko z’embuto obutatulugunyizibwa balala.
tip_73_content: Kozesa ebikoola bya muwogo, ebikoola by’enkindu oba obusaanyi wansi w’obusolya obw’ebyuma ebiriko amayinja ng’engeri ya buseere ey’okuziyiza ekizimbe.
tip_74_content: Kozesa emiwemba egyawuddwamu oba ebikondo by’embaawo ebisibiddwa ne waya ng’ebintu ebigumu, eby’okusiba ebikomera eby’ebbeeyi entono okudduka embizzi ebweru.
tip_75_content: Tumbira obusa bw’embizzi mu nsonda enkalu eragiddwa, bubikkeko ebikoola by’ebijanjaalo oba akaveera, buli wiiki bukyuse n’ekisero okukola nnakavundira.
tip_76_content: Teeka ekyuma ekigaaya ggaasi ow’obuveera ekyangu era eky’ebbeeyi entono okulongoosa obusa bw’embizzi, okuvaamu ggaasi ow’obwereere ow’okufumba awaka.
tip_77_content: Kuŋŋaanya amazzi amakyafu okuva mu kunaaba ekkalaamu mu kinnya ekitereka, gafukiremu amazzi amayonjo, era gakozese okufukirira ebijanjaalo oba ebirime.
tip_78_content: Saasaanya oluwuzi lw’obusa obukalu ku mikutu gy’obusa okusobola okunyiga obuwoowo n’okukala kasasiro, kyangu okusekula.
tip_79_content: Teeka emidumu egyangu (nga okozesa emiwemba egyasaliddwa ekitundu oba payipu za PVC eza layisi) okukyusa amazzi g’enkuba okuva mu binnya n’ebiyumba by’obusa.
tip_7_content: Kendeeza ku situleesi y’okuggya embizzi ku mabeere ng’ofulumya enkoko y’embizzi okuva mu kifo we bazaala n’oleka abaana b’embizzi mu mbeera gye bamanyi okumala wiiki esooka.
tip_80_content: Singa okuziika tekusoboka, zimba ekibbo kya nnakavundira eky’enjawulo ng’okozesa paleedi z’embaawo okukola nnakavundira y’embizzi enfu mu nfuufu enkalu.
tip_80_title: Okukola nnakavundira mu mbizzi enfu ennyangu
tip_81_content: Zimba akabokisi akatono aka seminti akasengejja mu mukutu gw’amazzi agakulukuta okusobola okukwata obusa obugumu nga amazzi amakyafu tegannaba kuyingira mu kidiba oba mu lusuku.
tip_82_content: Sima ebisaka oba emiti ebikula amangu (nga ebimera by’ebijanjaalo oba enniimu) okwetooloola embizzi okuziyiza empewo n’okukendeeza ku kuwunya.
tip_83_content: Zimba ekifo eky’enjawulo eky’embaawo oba seminti ekigulumivu okusobola okukala obusa obugumu mu musana nga tonnabupakira mu nsawo okutundibwa ng’ekigimusa.
tip_84_content: Olongoosa emikutu gy’amazzi agakulukuta buli lunaku ng’okozesa ekyuma ekisekula eky’enjawulo okutangira amazzi agasibye, ensiri okuzaala n’okuwunya obubi.
tip_85_content: Mukwano n’abalimi b’enva endiirwa oba ebirime abali okumpi okukyusakyusa obusa bw’embizzi n’ofuna kasasiro w’ebirime, obusaanyi oba ebiva mu mmere y’empeke.
tip_86_content: Busa obusa bw’embizzi obukoleddwa mu nnakavundira ku ttaka ly’ebirime waakiri wiiki 2 nga tonnasimba, okusinga butereevu ku nva endiirwa ezirima.
tip_87_content: Entuumu z’okutereka obusa zikuume nga zibikkiddwako akasolya ka ttaapu oba akasero okutangira enkuba okunaaba ebiriisa eby’omuwendo ebirime.
tip_88_content: Kozesa ekitundu kya plywood oba ekiveera ekya square eky’enjawulo (sorting board) okulungamya n’okutambuza embizzi mpola, okusinga okukozesa emiggo.
tip_89_content: Tambula mpola mu bipande buli ku makya n’akawungeezi. Weetegereze oba embizzi zonna ziyimirira, nga zikola, era nga zirabika nga zaagala emmere.
tip_89_title: Okutambula Emirundi Ebbiri Buli Lunaku Pen Walks
tip_8_content: Zibira empewo ennyogovu mu kiyumba ky’abaana ng’oteeka kateni ez’ekiseera oba ebipande by’embaawo okutuuka ku buwanvu bw’embizzi (nga sentimita 50).
tip_8_title: Ebbago ly'okuziyiza abaana abaggya ku mabeere
tip_90_content: Kozesa ekintu eky’enjawulo ekya V-notch okukuba amatu g’embizzi okusobola okuzuula, ng’otta obuwuka mu mwenge oluvannyuma lwa buli mwana w’embizzi.
tip_91_content: Teebereza obuzito bw’embizzi ng’okozesa ekipima eky’okutunga eky’enjawulo (pima obuwanvu bw’omutima n’obuwanvu, olwo obale obuzito) singa minzaani eba ya bbeeyi nnyo.
tip_92_content: Okusala embizzi ensajja nga tezinnaweza nnaku 7. Ku myaka gino, enkola eno eba ya mangu, ewona mangu era ereeta obulumi obutono.
tip_93_content: Embizzi zitambuze mu katale ku makya oba akawungeezi nga bunnyogovu, era osse ekisiikirize ku mmotoka y’entambula n’ebikoola bya muwogo.
tip_94_content: Mu ddundiro muteeke akatabo akatono aka layisi okuwandiika ennaku z’okuzaala, ennaku z’okuzaala n’engeri buli nsolo gy’egenda okujjanjaba.
tip_95_content: Wandiika amateeka amang’angu agakwata ku faamu buli lunaku (nga okunaaba mu ngalo, okuyonja ebiyumba, okukebera amazzi) ku lubaawo okumpi n’omulyango gw’ekiraalo.
tip_96_content: Muyigirize abaana oba abayambi ku ffaamu okukwata embizzi mpola, weewale okusamba oba okusika omukira, ekifuula embizzi ez’omu nsiko ate ez’obulabe.
tip_97_content: Emmere etereke mu baketi z’obuveera ezisibiddwa oba endongo z’amafuta okuziyiza okusikiriza ebibe, envunza n’emisota okujja ku faamu.
tip_98_content: Kebera abanywa amazzi emirundi ebiri buli lunaku ng’onyiga n’olugalo okukakasa nti amazzi gakulukuta mu ddembe ate nga tegazibiddwa bucaafu.
tip_99_content: Cull enkoko ezilemererwa okufuna embuto oluvannyuma lw’okugezaako okuzaala emirundi ebiri n’embizzi ekakakasiddwa, oba ezo ezirina obuzaale obutono (wansi w’abaana b’embizzi 6).
tip_9_title: Ekitundu ky'emmere y'emmere ey'ekika kya DIY Creep
tos_acceptance_content: Bw’oyingira n’okukozesa app ya SmartSwine, okkirizza okusibwa ku Mateeka gano ag’Empeereza. Bw’oba ​​tokkiriziganya na mateeka gano, nsaba tokozesa mpeereza.
tos_availability_content: Tufuba okulaba nga tufuna obudde bwa 99% naye tetukakasa kufuna mpeereza eno awatali kutaataaganyizibwa. Data backups ziweebwa nga ekintu ekiyamba; wabula abakozesa bakubirizibwa okukuuma ebiwandiiko byabwe.
tos_changes_content: Tulina eddembe okukyusa mu mateeka gano ekiseera kyonna. Okwongera okukozesa app kitegeeza okukkiriza ebiragiro ebipya.
tos_contact_content: Okufuna obuwagizi oba okubuuza mu mateeka, tuukirira omukugu ng’oyita mu nteekateeka za pulofayilo ya app.
tos_data_privacy_content:
Osigaza obwannannyini ku data gy’oyingiza (data y’ekisibo, eby’ensimbi, e.t.c.). 
Data yo eya faamu eterekebwa bulungi nga tukozesa Google Firebase, wadde nga tufuba okukuuma data yo, tetusobola kukakasa bukuumi bwonna. 
Bw’osobozesa Cloud Backup, okkirizza okutereka n’okukwataganya data yo mu byuma byo byonna. 
Tetuguza bantu ba kusatu bikwata ku muntu wo oba ku faamu yo.
Ggwe ovunaanyizibwa ku butuufu bwa data eyingiziddwa. Data enkyamu mu modulo za "Feed" oba "Financials" eyinza okuvaamu okubala okutali kutuufu.
tos_description_content:
"SmartSwine" egaba ebikozesebwa mu kuddukanya faamu omuli, naye nga tebikoma ku:
• Okulondoola ekisibo n’ebikwata ku bulamu.
• Okukuuma ebiwandiiko by’ebyensimbi.
• Enzirukanya y’abakozi.
• Ebiteeso by’okuzuula obulwadde nga biyambibwako AI.
• Amawulire agakwata ku kutuuka ku katale.
tos_financial_data_content: Module ya "Financials" kye kimu ku bikozesebwa mu kulondoola era tekikola kuwabula kwa bakugu mu kubala ebitabo oba ku musolo. Abakozesa bakubirizibwa okufulumya amawulire gaabwe ebweru okwekenneenya ababalirizi b’ebitabo abakakasibwa.
tos_liability_content: SmartSwine app eweebwa "nga bweri." Okutuuka ku kigero ekisinga okukkirizibwa mu mateeka, abagikola tebajja kuvunaanyizibwa ku kwonooneka kwonna obutereevu, obutatereevu, mu butanwa, oba okuva mu kukozesa oba obutasobola kukozesa mpeereza, omuli okufiirwa ebisolo oba obutakwatagana mu by’ensimbi.
tos_no_medical_content:
Ebintu bya "Feed Calculator", "Feed Formulator", "Symptoms Analyzer" ne "Disease Finder" bya kusomesa na kuwa mawulire byokka.
• Ebivudde mu AI bikolebwa algorithms era si kifo kya kubuulirira kw’abasawo b’ebisolo okw’ekikugu, okuzuula obulwadde, oba okujjanjaba.
• Omukozesa akiriza okwebuuza ku musawo w’ebisolo alina layisinsi nga tannasalawo ku mmere yonna n’obujjanjabi ku bikwata ku bisolo.
• Nnannyini App tavunaanyizibwa ku kufiirwa oba okwonooneka kw’ebisolo byonna ebiva mu kukozesa app n’ebintu byayo.
tos_no_medical_title: 4. Tewali magezi ga basawo oba abasawo b’ebisolo (Critical Disclaimer) .
tos_prohibited_content:
Abakozesa bakkiriziganya obutakola:
• Kozesa app eno ku bigendererwa byonna ebimenya amateeka.
• Gezaako okukyusa yinginiya w’enkola.
• Okuyingiza data y’ebyensimbi ey’obufere n’ekigendererwa eky’okulimba abantu ab’okusatu.
tos_user_resp_content: Abakozesa bavunaanyizibwa okukuuma ebyama by’ebiwandiiko byabwe ku akawunti. Ggwe ovunaanyizibwa ku mirimu gyonna egikolebwa wansi wa akawunti yo.

emergency_containment_protocol_steps:
1. 🔒 Immediate Quarantine: Seal affected pen immediately; restrict personnel access.
2. 🚫 Movement Freeze: Cease all live pig, pork, feed, and manure shipments off-farm.
3. 🧼 Disinfect: Deploy boot baths & tyre dips with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda.
4. 📞 Mandatory Reporting: Contact your District Veterinary Officer immediately.
5. ⚠️ No Slaughter: Do not slaughter sick or suspect animals for meat.
bio_proto_asf: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY QUARANTINE: African Swine Fever is a lethal, legally notifiable virus. 1) Lock down farm gates immediately. 2) Stop all movement of pigs, vehicles, feed, and manure. 3) Disinfect all boot baths and tyres with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda. 4) Contact your District/National Veterinary Officer immediately.
bio_proto_fmd: NOTIFIABLE EPIDEMIC ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease spreads rapidly through aerosols and equipment. 1) Quarantine suspect pen immediately. 2) No live pigs or personnel movement off-site. 3) Setup tyre baths and boot dips with approved disinfectant. 4) Notify livestock authorities immediately.
bio_proto_csf: NOTIFIABLE DISEASE ALERT: Classical Swine Fever (Hog Cholera). 1) Restrict pen access and isolate suspect animals. 2) Halt all pig sales and shipments. 3) Wear dedicated boots/overalls. 4) Report to official state veterinary services immediately.
bio_proto_anthrax: DANGER - ZOONOTIC EMERGENCY: Bacillus anthracis can infect humans. 1) DO NOT OPEN CARCASSES (exposure to air causes resistant spores). 2) Isolate surviving pigs. 3) Wear full PPE. 4) Call veterinary authorities for safe incineration or deep burial with quicklime.
bio_proto_pseudorabies: NOTIFIABLE HERPESVIRUS ALERT: Pseudorabies / Aujeszky's causes severe neurological fatality in piglets. 1) Strict pen quarantine. 2) Control wild animals and rodents. 3) Notify state veterinary authorities immediately.
bio_proto_rabies: FATAL ZOONOTIC ALERT: Rabies transmits to humans through saliva and bites. 1) DO NOT HANDLE PIG WITH BARE HANDS. 2) Secure pen tightly. 3) Alert veterinary and public health authorities immediately.
bio_proto_vesicular_stomatitis: REPORTABLE VESICULAR LESION ALERT: Vesicular Stomatitis is clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease. 1) Isolate infected pigs immediately. 2) Wear protective gloves. 3) Report to state veterinarian for lab differential diagnosis.
bio_proto_senecavirus: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Senecavirus A lesions are clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). 1) Quarantine pen immediately. 2) Restrict off-farm movement. 3) Notify livestock veterinary authorities for mandatory differential PCR testing.
bio_proto_svd: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Swine Vesicular Disease (SVD). 1) Strict isolation of infected animals. 2) Restrict all vehicle and visitor movements. 3) Report to state animal health department immediately.
